description: Family tree of Brassicaceae. `taxonomy`: the rank hierarchy (family → subfamily → supertribe → tribe → genus) from World Flora Online, with species counts. `phylogeny`: the branching order of the genera from the Open Tree of Life synthetic tree, which merges published DNA studies. Each clade lists the supertribes and tribes it contains and its number of genera; `clade` is the name of the group where Open Tree names one. Each genus has its tribe, supertribe and species count. Clades marked `unresolved` hold genera that are not one natural group in the tree, so they can only be placed at a shared ancestor. `notInPhylogeny` lists genera that could not be placed, with the reason.

sources.name: World Flora Online Plant List 2026-06, via ChecklistBank (https://www.checklistbank.org/dataset/2004)
Open Tree of Life synthetic tree opentree16.1 (1931 studies, https://tree.opentreeoflife.org)
